column1: # file<TAB>suite — which check covers the file. An exact match or a dir prefix.
# Used by scripts/verify-changed.sh: past an edit runs static plus only the touched
# suites instead of the whole layer (5.5 min down to seconds).
# The -check suffix (scripts-check, docs-check, pairchat-check): no separate suite,
# covered by static (verify-changed.sh: static always runs).
# Cross-suite pins (STOP seq 1187): these modules' output is asserted by
# test_protocol.py, so their edits also run the protocol suite.
